interventions.detail: Used Python 3.10 venv via uv (package classifiers list up to 3.10)
Installed from repo source with [test] extra since pytest.ini requires mypy/flake8/cov plugins
Pinned pytest<8 because pytest-flake8 fails to load with newer pytest
Set PYTEST_ADDOPTS=--cov-fail-under=0 since pytest.ini's 80% coverage gate fails on a single test file
